title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legal research is a core and time-consuming legal workflow. Lawyers must identify controlling authority, verify that it remains valid, reconcile statutes and cases, and synthesize a grounded answer. Language model agents are a natural fit for this retrieval-intensive workflow, and automating even part of it would be valuable. But that value depends on reliability: a single missing authority, stale citation, or wrong legal conclusion can make an otherwise plausible answer unusable. We introduce \textbf{Legal Research Bench} (LRB), a benchmark of 413 open-ended U.S. legal research questions written by experts, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities, and a binary grading rubric. We evaluate thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing, and retrieval tools. We score agent responses through all-pass grading with source verification, where a response is correct only if every required crit

translated_title: 法律研究基准：衡量长周期法律研究智能体的端到端可靠性
translated_abstract: 法律研究是一项核心且耗时的法律工作流程。律师必须识别具有约束力的法律权威依据，验证其是否仍然有效，协调法规与判例之间的关系，并综合出有据可依的答案。语言模型智能体天然适合这种检索密集型的工作流程，即使将其部分自动化也将具有很高的价值。但这种价值取决于可靠性：一个遗漏的权威依据、过时的引用或错误的法律结论，都可能使一个看似合理的答案变得无法使用。我们提出了法律研究基准，这是一个包含413个开放式美国法律研究问题的基准，这些问题由专家撰写，每个问题都配有标准答案、支持性权威依据以及二元评分标准。我们在一个配备网络搜索、判例法搜索、网页解析和检索工具的测试环境中评估了十三个前沿模型。我们通过带来源验证的全通过评分方式对智能体的回答进行评分，即只有当每一个必需的关键要素（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了法律研究基准，一个包含413个专家撰写的开放式美国法律研究问题的基准，通过带来源验证的全通过评分方式，衡量长周期法律研究智能体的端到端可靠性，并评估了十三个前沿模型。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Legal Research Bench (LRB), a benchmark of 413 expert-written open-ended U.S. legal research questions that measures the end-to-end reliability of long-horizon legal research agents through all-pass grading with source verification, evaluating thirteen frontier models.
